visual_action: A slideshow-style video cycling through close-up portrait photos of multiple House Republican members, one per slide. Each frame fills the vertical screen with a single politician's face/headshot. Some appear to be official congressional portrait photos (U.S. flag in background, congressional seal pin visible); others appear to be press/event photos. Every frame has the same lower-third red alert overlay with flashing red siren emojis and the identical warning text. The slideshow moves through approximately 8 politicians in sequence.
